fact: On 18 June 2026 the FOLUCCO director general said a pilot digitalising the Gombe Tribunal de paix and its parquet would be launched with funding already available, under the Justice 2.0 programme whose projects include an integrated case management system and a national database of decisions.
title: Justice 2.0 : un projet pilote de digitalisation des juridictions bientôt lancé à Kinshasa
